title: GST Portal Rolls Out emSigner 3.3 for New DSC USB Dongles (September 21, 2026)
content:
# GST Portal Rolls Out emSigner 3.3 for New DSC USB Dongles (September 21, 2026)

Ek important update hai! Government ne GST Portal par naya emSigner version 3.3 roll out kiya hai. Yeh naya update 21st September 2026 se issue hone wale naye Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) USB dongles ke liye compatibility provide karega.

**Key Details:**

*   **What's New:** GSTN ne emSigner version 3.3 available kar diya hai.
*   **Effective From:** This version is essential for DSC USB tokens issued *on or after* 21st September 2026.
*   **For Existing DSC Users:** Agar aapka existing valid DSC aur USB token smoothly work kar raha hai, toh immediate upgrade ki zaroorat nahi hai. Aap apna current emSigner version use kar sakte hain.
*   **For New DSC Users:** Jin taxpayers ko 21st September 2026 ya uske baad naya DSC USB dongle (new certificate, renewal in a new dongle, or replacement token) milega, unhe emSigner 3.3 install karna hoga. Older versions in naye tokens ke saath kaam nahi karenge.
*   **System Requirements:** Naye version ke liye 64-bit operating system aur Java 1.8 ki zaroorat padegi. Java 9 aur uske baad ke versions supported nahi hain.
*   **Download Location:** Aap emSigner 3.3 ko GST Portal ke DSC/emSigner section se download kar sakte hain.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.gst.gov.in)

*Published on: 21 September 2026*
